{ "cells": [ { "cell_type": "markdown", "source": [ "# Patient-Specific Digital Twin for Hypertension\n", "\n", "---\n", "\n", "Hypertension affects approximately 1.28 billion adults worldwide and is\n", "the leading modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular disease and stroke.\n", "Clinical management remains largely reactive — treatment is initiated\n", "after sustained elevated readings rather than through anticipation of\n", "individual physiological trajectories.\n", "\n", "This project builds a patient-specific digital twin for hypertension.\n", "Rather than predicting a single blood pressure value, the twin maintains\n", "an internal representation of a patient's vascular state and simulates\n", "how that state evolves over time under natural aging and clinical\n", "interventions.\n", "\n", "---\n", "\n", "## Internal State Representation\n", "\n", "Blood pressure measurements — systolic (SBP) and diastolic (DBP) — are\n", "observations. They are noisy, correlated, and do not individually\n", "represent distinct physiological mechanisms.\n", "\n", "The twin instead operates on two clinically validated quantities that\n", "each capture a specific and independent aspect of vascular physiology:\n", "\n", "**Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)** represents the time-averaged driving\n", "pressure across the cardiac cycle and summarizes overall vascular\n", "pressure burden and peripheral resistance.\n", "\n", "$$MAP \\cong DBP + \\frac{1}{3}(SBP - DBP) = \\frac{SBP + 2 \\times DBP}{3}$$\n", "\n", "The 1/3 and 2/3 weighting reflects the fact that at resting heart rate,\n", "diastole occupies approximately two thirds of the cardiac cycle. This is\n", "an approximation that holds under resting conditions.\n", "\n", "*Klabunde RE. Cardiovascular Physiology Concepts, 2nd ed.\n", "cvphysiology.com — Hemodynamics section.*\n", "\n", "*Magder S (2013). The meaning of blood pressure.\n", "Critical Care, 17(2):227. PMID: 30305136*\n", "\n", "---\n", "\n", "**Pulse Pressure (PP)** is the difference between systolic and diastolic\n", "pressure and serves as a non-invasive surrogate for large artery\n", "stiffness. As arteries stiffen with age, their capacity to absorb\n", "pulsatile energy decreases and pulse pressure widens.\n", "\n", "$$PP = SBP - DBP$$\n", "\n", "*Franklin SS et al. (1999). Is pulse pressure useful in predicting risk\n", "for coronary heart disease? The Framingham Heart Study.\n", "Circulation, 100(4):354–360. PMID: 10421594*\n", "\n", "---\n", "\n", "Together these form the internal state vector of the twin:\n", "\n", "$$z(t) = [z_1(t),\\ z_2(t)] = [MAP(t),\\ PP(t)]$$\n", "\n", "The transformation back to clinical measurements is exact and requires\n", "no statistical machinery:\n", "\n", "$$SBP = MAP + \\frac{2}{3} \\times PP$$\n", "\n", "$$DBP = MAP - \\frac{1}{3} \\times PP$$\n", "\n", "---\n", "\n", "## State Evolution\n", "\n", "The vascular state evolves according to a first-order relaxation equation:\n", "\n", "$$z(t+1) = z(t) + \\lambda \\left( z_{\\text{target}}(t) - z(t) \\right)$$\n", "\n", "Where z_target is the physiological equilibrium predicted from the\n", "patient's current risk profile and λ controls the rate of adaptation.\n", "This formulation reflects the fact that biological systems adapt\n", "gradually rather than instantaneously.\n", "\n", "*Olufsen MS & Ottesen JT (2013). A practical approach to parameter\n", "estimation applied to model predicting heart rate regulation.\n", "Journal of Mathematical Biology, 67(1):39–68. PMID: 22588357*\n", "\n", "---\n", "\n", "## Data Source and Limitations\n", "\n", "Model parameters are derived from the National Health and Nutrition\n", "Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017–2018 cycle, a nationally\n", "representative cross-sectional survey of the US civilian population.\n", "\n", "NHANES is cross-sectional. Longitudinal drift parameters are therefore\n", "inferred from age-stratified population differences rather than tracked\n", "individuals. This is an acknowledged constraint and all dynamic\n", "parameters should be interpreted accordingly." ], "metadata": { "id": "PG45StKH0Qzg" } }, { "cell_type": "code", "source": [ "!pip install pandas numpy matplotlib scikit-learn -q\n", "print(\"Completed!\")" ], "metadata": { "id": "YH9r_TR00QlY", "colab": { "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/" }, "outputId": "b68258f0-c2cf-4dc0-9be2-bd1bea3d9c2a" }, "execution_count": 1, "outputs": [ { "output_type": "stream", "name": "stdout", "text": [ "Completed!\n" ] } ] }, { "cell_type": "markdown", "source": [ "## Data Loading\n", "\n", "All datasets are sourced from the NHANES 2017–2018 cycle and stored\n", "in Google Drive.
